evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2015 (11 years old), 70 m E: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).

1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).
